github_sync_rules_scope_target_check.name: github_sync_rules_scope_target_check
github_sync_rules_scope_target_check.value:
("github_sync_rules"."scope" = 'all' AND "github_sync_rules"."org" IS NULL AND "github_sync_rules"."repo" IS NULL)
        OR ("github_sync_rules"."scope" = 'org' AND "github_sync_rules"."org" IS NOT NULL AND "github_sync_rules"."repo" IS NULL)
        OR ("github_sync_rules"."scope" = 'repo' AND "github_sync_rules"."org" IS NOT NULL AND "github_sync_rules"."repo" IS NOT NULL)

oauth_tokens_refresh_metadata_required.name: oauth_tokens_refresh_metadata_required
oauth_tokens_refresh_metadata_required.value: "oauth_tokens"."provider" = 'github' OR ("oauth_tokens"."refresh_token" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_tokens"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

edits_action_field_check.name: edits_action_field_check
edits_action_field_check.value: ("edits"."action" = 'create' AND "edits"."field" IS NULL) OR ("edits"."action" = 'update' AND "edits"."field" IS NOT NULL)

edits_field_target_check.name: edits_field_target_check
edits_field_target_check.value:
"edits"."field" IS NULL
        OR ("edits"."page_id" IS NULL AND "edits"."comment_id" IS NULL AND "edits"."field" IN ('title', 'description'))
        OR ("edits"."page_id" IS NOT NULL AND "edits"."field" IN ('title', 'content'))
        OR ("edits"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "edits"."field" = 'content')

edits_target_exclusive_check.name: edits_target_exclusive_check
edits_target_exclusive_check.value: NOT ("edits"."page_id" IS NOT NULL AND "edits"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL)
